row: Our motto, "We Take Care of Our Own®" says it all. NCMIC was founded in 1946 by chiropractors for chiropractors. Today, we have grown to become the largest provider of chiropractic malpractice insurance in the nation. "We Take Care of Our Own" is not just a slogan at NCMIC; it's about how the company does business every day.
